bio.text: John Duresky, a Democrat, advanced from the August 2026 primary for Washington's 4th Congressional District, where he faces Republican Amanda McKinney in November.
According to MyNorthwest, he served 24 years in the U.S. Air Force, reaching the rank of major, and an additional 13 years in federal civilian service.

sources.title: Trump-endorsed McKinney, Democrat Duresky advance in WA-4 primary to replace Newhouse - MyNorthwest.com
